scenarios.name: Import redirect (spec Appendix B)
scenarios.description: auth is rewired from database to identity. Package topology moves only after both files change.

scenarios.name: Manifest dependency added
scenarios.description: A package.json edit alone produces a blast radius.

scenarios.name: Invalid intermediate state
scenarios.description: Parse fails mid-edit. Old facts must survive as stale, not vanish.

scenarios.name: Rename via delete + create
scenarios.description: A heuristic edge is upgraded to exact by a git reconcile checkpoint.

scenarios.name: Wide refactor burst
scenarios.description: Every TypeScript file changes at once. Stress for layout and for the meaning of 'changed'.

scenarios.name: New package appears
scenarios.description: A package absent from the baseline is created and wired in mid-session.

scenarios.name: Hub change (logger)
scenarios.description: @acme/logger changes. 7 of 8 packages impacted; every path runs through a hub.
